# meshstack_workspace_user_groups (Data Source)

List workspace user groups, optionally only those that match the filters. Use it to find a group that your identity provider created through SCIM, whose identifier meshStack generates: filter by `egid` and pass `one(data.meshstack_workspace_user_groups.<name>.workspace_user_groups).metadata.name` as `subject.name` of a `meshstack_workspace_group_binding` or `meshstack_project_group_binding`.

meshStack filters by `egid` and `display_name` since 2026.50.0. An older meshStack lists all groups, and the provider applies the filters itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find a group that your identity provider created through SCIM by its ID there,
# such as the object ID of an Entra ID group.
data "meshstack_workspace_user_groups" "developers" {
  egid = "5f0c2a8e-7d1b-4c3a-9e6f-2b8d4a1c7e93"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) List only groups with this display name. The match ignores case. Display names are not unique, so the list can have several groups.
- `egid` (String) List only the group with this identifier in the system it comes from, such as the object ID of an Entra ID group. meshStack keeps it unique, so the list has at most one group.
- `owned_by_workspace` (String) List only groups that this workspace owns. For global groups, set it to `meshcloud-global-partner`.

### Read-Only

- `workspace_user_groups` (Attributes List) The workspace user groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace_user_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--workspace_user_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace_user_groups`

Read-Only:

- `metadata` (Attributes) Identifiers of the workspace user group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace_user_groups--metadata))
- `ref` (Attributes) Reference to this workspace user group, can be used as `group_ref` in `meshstack_workspace_user_group_member`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace_user_groups--ref))
- `spec` (Attributes) Configuration of the workspace user group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace_user_groups--spec))
- `status` (Attributes) Information meshStack keeps about the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace_user_groups--status))

<a id="nestedatt--workspace_user_groups--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace_user_groups.metadata`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Identifier of the workspace user group.
- `owned_by_workspace` (String) Identifier of the workspace that owns the group.


<a id="nestedatt--workspace_user_groups--ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace_user_groups.ref`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) meshObject type, always `meshWorkspaceUserGroup`.
- `name` (String) Named identifier (`metadata.name`) of the `meshWorkspaceUserGroup`.
- `owned_by_workspace` (String) Named identifier (`metadata.name`) of the `meshWorkspace` that owns the `meshWorkspaceUserGroup`.


<a id="nestedatt--workspace_user_groups--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace_user_groups.spec`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Name of the group as meshPanel shows it.
- `egid` (String) Identifier of the group in the system it comes from, such as your identity provider.
- `members` (Set of String) Usernames of the group's members.
- `tags` (Map of List of String) Tags of `meshWorkspaceUserGroup`.


<a id="nestedatt--workspace_user_groups--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace_user_groups.status`

Read-Only:

- `disabled_usernames` (Set of String) Members whose user is disabled, for example by SCIM.
- `source_system` (String) System that manages the group, such as `SCIM` for a group your identity provider synchronizes.
